source_excerpts.text:
For the actual nested Bell-prefix source, K is the inaccessible boundary between useful Bell pairs and the suffix. Put B=E[K]ln D, H=H(K), and let R be the reliable net entanglement rate in nats per queue under the complete residual/output contract. The internally reviewed universal bounds are

\[
\max\{0,H-\ln(H+1)-5.012468686862438\}
\le B-R\le H+4\ln2.
\]

Consequently **(B−R)/H tends to1 for every growing-entropy family of finite priors**, including varying local dimension. The order of limits matters: first take many independent complete queues at a fixed finite source, then vary the source family. There is no supplied clock record, hidden Bell label or free entangled aid.

Root's alignment-mixture construction and subsequent support/surprisal partitions supplied separable comparison states on the original registers. The comparison selects no physical boundary; it bounds what all admitted receivers can do. A separate reviewed result identifies an acquisition target: for an actual-source-preserving duplicated record Z, restoring the full supply B is equivalent to H(K^r|Z)=o(r). That theorem specifies the information an instrument would need; it does not acquire such an instrument.

Why this matters: inaccessible information has an unavoidable operational price. It cannot be turned into available entanglement merely by assuming a useful representation or record. The exact additive second-order loss remains unresolved. Our attempted pointwise sharpening failed on an actual native GHZ construction. A later completed separable measurement also defeats a proposed averaged constant within the separable relaxation; an LOCC implementation and a capacity consequence are not established.

Evidence: [universal proof](/Users/harjas/Documents/Codex/2026-10-23/astra-civilisation-changing-discovery-with-35-2/outputs/proofs/UNIVERSAL_INVENTORY_ENTROPY.md), [fresh dimension-free review](/Users/harjas/Documents/Codex/2026-10-23/astra-civilisation-changing-discovery-with-35-2/outputs/reviews/INVENTORY_DIMENSION_FREE.md), and the exact record/currency/counterexample entries in the ledger. The corrected stripped two-queue swap lemma is mathematical capital, not a theorem for arbitrary native prefix vectors.

# Every growing-entropy prior has leading inventory-loss coefficient one

W18 independent continuation, 23 October 2026. Built after root's alignment-mixture proof by replacing its full-grid partitions with support-only partitions and then choosing classes by surprisal scale. Internal proof candidate; fresh review requested. Historical novelty and external correctness UNKNOWN.

## Governing source and limits

Use the unchanged pinned Cycle11 Ultra source and complete residual/output contract in PROOF.md Section1, with fixed finite D,L>=2, known p on K in {1,...,L}, zeros permitted. Let

rho_p=sum_k p_k sigma_k,
sigma_k=Phi_D^k tensor nu_D^(L-k),
B=EK lnD, H=H(K), C_p=H(K|Y)<=c(D^-2),
S(rho_p)=2(L-EK)lnD+H-C_p.

The actual K clocks, old memory and mathematical Bell label Y remain inaccessible. No entangled aid, shared initial inventory record or physical offset is supplied. First take r iid complete queues to infinity at each fixed source; only afterwards vary priors and L. Nothing below specifies a receiver or modifies the actual source.

For t>=2 let zeta_t=(I+t Phi_t)/[t(t+1)], a separable full-rank isotropic boundary state. A pure t-level pair contributes ln t to cross entropy against zeta_t; white noise contributes 2ln t+A_t, where

A_t=(1-t^-2)ln(t+1)-ln t, 0<A_t<=1/t.

Empty blocks are omitted and contribute zero.

0,b_1,b_2,...,b_m,L,
